title: Make build_type dir-driven (loosen the schema enum)
description: Change build_type in contracts/schemas/v1/requirements.schema.json from the closed enum [game,cli,app,library,other] to a format-validated slug string (pattern ^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]*$, optional). The templates/ directory plus scaffold's existing 'no template for build_type' error remain the real gate. Verify the custom validator enforces the pattern (and drop any enum special-casing in cli/lib/validate.js if present). Test-first.
acceptance_criteria: build_type is declared as an optional slug-pattern string; the closed enum is gone.
plan compile accepts a valid slug build_type (e.g. cli, library) and a requirements.json with no build_type, and rejects a malformed value (e.g. "Not A Slug").
Existing cli and scaffold-phase requirements still validate; a test covers valid/omitted/invalid cases; full suite passes.
